hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Adjusts LP swap fees dynamically based on on-chain price volatility using EWMA of sqrt price changes; collects a configurable owner-controlled protocol fee share from the spread above the base fee into a treasury address. In practice, the afterInitialize flag is absent from the address bitmask, so pool configs are never populated and the hook always returns a hardcoded 3000 bps fallback fee.
